authority.resource_observation_policy: verify the selected registered environment before every stateful qualification action
authority.credentials_policy: qualification uses only the disposable credentials declared by compose.yaml; external publication credentials remain GitHub environment secret references
authority.fallback_policy: none; an unavailable or conflicting resource stops only the dependent qualification

qualification_environments.purpose: fixed-candidate Core 0.1.0 aggregate, browser, recovery, performance, starter and package-projection qualification
qualification_environments.owner: Peanut Admin Core release qualification owner
qualification_environments.service_type: isolated Docker Compose qualification stack plus host toolchain
qualification_environments.credential_ref: compose.yaml qualification-only disposable defaults; GitHub npm-release environment for publication credentials
qualification_environments.database: peanut_admin_core_q010 plus test-owned peanut_admin_* databases inside the isolated MySQL volume
qualification_environments.namespace: Docker Compose project peanut-admin-core-q010 and its isolated mysql-data/cache-data volumes
qualification_environments.data_source: the exact locked Core candidate tree and repository-owned synthetic fixtures
qualification_environments.freshness_requirement: the Compose project, containers and volumes must be absent before the candidate starts; all databases are created by that candidate and destroyed after evidence capture

health_check.toolchain: verify the exact versions recorded above before start
health_check.allocation: all six registered ports are free and docker compose --project-name peanut-admin-core-q010 ps --all has no resources before start
health_check.mysql: credential-backed PDO ping to 127.0.0.1:20220 after the isolated stack starts
health_check.cache: RESP PING to 127.0.0.1:20221 after the isolated stack starts

qualification_environments.cleanup_responsibility: the qualification owner runs docker compose --project-name peanut-admin-core-q010 down --volumes --remove-orphans after success or after preserving failure evidence
qualification_environments.publication_side_effects: none; qualification never creates a source tag, Registry version or GitHub Release

external_publication.purpose: tag-triggered Composer split, Packagist, npm and GitHub Release publication
external_publication.service_type: GitHub, Packagist and npm public registries
external_publication.version: immutable SemVer tag and package version selected by the release contract
external_publication.credential_ref: GitHub environment npm-release: CORE_SPLIT_DEPLOY_KEY, PACKAGIST_USERNAME and PACKAGIST_API_TOKEN; npm trusted publisher binding
external_publication.data_source: the exact qualified origin/main commit and annotated tag
external_publication.freshness_requirement: read-only preflight verifies target-version absence or exact resumable identity immediately before publication
external_publication.health_check: the tag workflow verifies repository access, Packagist API access and clean Registry consumers
external_publication.cleanup_responsibility: not applicable; published identities are immutable
